title: UI风格#162 - Noir Minimal (黑色极简)

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Noir Minimal style When color palette Then features pure black, pure white, gray, single red accent
Given Noir Minimal style When typography Then uses minimal noir: Inter, Roboto Mono, or Space Mono
acceptance_criteria.evidence: Implemented: Inter (title 2rem 300/700 weight), Roboto Mono (body/UI 0.7-0.85rem) - stark minimal typography with mono accents

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Noir Minimal style When layout Then minimal elements, deep shadows, single focal point, stark contrast
acceptance_criteria.evidence: Implemented: stark black background, subtle spotlight radial gradient, single red dot accent, 1px borders, minimalist spacing

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Noir Minimal style When UI elements Then shadow play, spotlight, minimal motion, tension

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Noir Minimal UI When functional Then includes shadow chat, agent agents, tension stats
